snippet.title: The Awakener: Forgotten Oath – PS5 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The roguelike action game The Awakener: Forgotten Oath is now available on PlayStation®5!
 Become the Chosen Awakener and fight through the Void Realm with sword and magic.
